# storage_box — realism QA

Status: **provisional_B_not_certified**. Grades: evidence B, silhouette B, proportions B, colour_texture B, material B, articulation B, physics B, collision A, instances B, cross_view B. Primary visible IoU: 0.860.

Evidence: f1479, f1489, f1496. Camera intrinsics and metric transforms: `../review/calibration.json`. Comparison: `../review/storage_box_compare.jpg`. Per-frame dimensions, IoU, histogram and mask provenance: `../qa_report.json`.

Changes:
- Corrected the top instance to an open upright tub with no lid or latches. Rebuilt 1.2 mm walls, thin lid crown/skirts and separately movable latches; removed absent-part mass from the open instance. Refit all three instances in three views.
- Rebuilt physical mass estimates from constituent density and thin-shell/contact geometry; updated part COM, affine instance mass and material-specific friction.
- Rebuilt reproducible Blender/GLB meshes and collision geometry; preserved instance and review metadata in standalone rebuilds.
- Seated the narrow gasket on the tub rim and added an explicit closed-latch retention constraint; opening requires releasing both latches.

Remaining:
- Mass, contents, friction, restitution and hidden wall thickness are unmeasured priors.
- Static visible-state evidence does not verify actuation force, thread pitch, seal behavior or fracture. Closed-retention constraints require explicit release actions in a runtime importer.

## Articulation audit

- Added unit front vector and preferred front view; exported MuJoCo/URDF with named retentions and explicit scaled world instances.
- Preserved joint names and all texture bytes; preserved unmeasured mechanism ranges and pump spring prior.
- Refit instance yaw/translation/scale with world +Z upright using fresh calibrated cameras.
- Reversed both latch axes to open outward, moved/thinned latch plates outside the lid skirt, and reduced rim/skirt clearance.

MuJoCo maximum sampled penetration: 5.201 mm before; 0.000 mm after. All scaled instance sweeps: PASS. Moving joints use ten samples including endpoints; welded/retained joints use their static state. Parent collisions are enabled. This is a discrete geometry test, not continuous collision detection or measured dynamics.

Native calibrated review: 9 instance/frame comparisons; worst full-object silhouette offset 33.54 px (limit 10 px). These photo masks were also used for fitting, not held-out validation. Hidden moving edges and approximate manual masks limit the measurement. Review: [photo/render/overlay](../review/artcheck_storage_box.jpg).

The supplied front-articulation files contain no matching small-asset joints. No operation of these joints was identified in the 2 Hz scan of the entire source video. Dense 101.4–103.9 s inspection shows rigid handling of the orange carton, not flap motion. Opening ranges, physical stops, physical axes, friction, mass and spring parameters remain unmeasured priors; no dynamic reprojection PASS is claimed.

Use `model.xml` for releasable welds/retentions and pump return spring. URDF cannot represent the extra carton-retention constraints; see `simulation_exports` in model.json. `instances/NN/world.xml` bakes size into geometry, anchors and slide travel before the rigid world pose, avoiding shearing during joint motion. GLB keeps its PBR textures; per-material UV meshes and source textures are also exported to MuJoCo and OBJ/MTL for URDF. MuJoCo glass uses approximate alpha instead of refractive ray tracing. Exported inertias are bounding-box estimates using inherited masses and centres of mass.

All work is offline, CPU only, nice 19, cores 16–19. Metric scale is inherited from the supplied reconstruction; no absolute-scale or online performance claim is made. See [artcheck_report.json](../artcheck_report.json) for all six checks and timing records.
